legenda: Monday, Nov. 12, 1906: a majority needed in the city and in the territory.
texto_para_tela: NOV. 12, 1906 · THE CITY · TERRITORY · a majority needed in both
nota: 12/11/1906 caiu numa segunda-feira (calendário gregoriano, conferido). O Times de 13/11 diz 'Annexation won yesterday'.
narracao: On the map, that is geometry. Two shapes that don't touch can't merge; a thin bridge of land makes them touch. That bridge is the strip, from the city's southern edge to the boundary lines of San Pedro and Wilmington. The vote came on Monday, November 12, 1906, in the city and in the territory to be annexed, since the law required a majority in both.
